expected_rate: When a Swing position is past T1 after a reconciliation-booked partial but has no trail; otherwise the tighten-only and one-share paths are validated from state and broker order history.
reversal: A Swing stop or trail moves in the adverse direction, a 1-share position crosses T1 without a profit lock, or an overnight trail advances without its broker stop following.

metrics.name: swing_profit_lock_integrity
metrics.source: logs/mtf_bot.log, trade_log.json, and Alpaca order history
metrics.bound: Zero loosened stops; zero eligible 1-share T1 crossings without a trail; broker stop at least as tight as the persisted trail after a successful replace.
